name: adf-dev
description: The Agentic Development Framework's development plugin: skills, agents, and a mod for building, running, and checking the code. Its mod shows the local environment's URL above the prompt, and whether it answers. /adf-dev:dev-env sets up, diagnoses, and safely resets a Docker Compose local environment (the docker module); like every module skill, it acts only in a packaged project that installed its module.
